request   POST https://api.example.com/v1/items
actor     research/agent
decision  deny
reason    no_route: the host is claimed for the actor and no route matches the method and path
policy    api-readonly (the first policy claiming the host; none allowed the request)

Policies claiming api.example.com for research/agent:
  api-readonly  Enforce, logAllowed  alone: deny (no_route)
  files-audit   Audit                alone: allow (route, /v1/**)

An Enforce policy claims the host, so the Audit policies' routes are not consulted.
